lines.speaker: Oak
lines.text: Start a session with the plus, and the workspace selector below the prompt box picks the place.

lines.speaker: Oak
lines.text: New worktree gives the session its own folder and branch beside your clone. That's the safe default.

lines.speaker: Oak
lines.text: Current checkout works right in your existing clone. Quick, but it touches your working folder.

lines.speaker: Oak
lines.text: Cloud runs it in a cloud sandbox on GitHub's hosted infrastructure.

lines.speaker: Oak
lines.text: Base branch sets the bough a new worktree grows from. And Create from always gets a new worktree.

lines.speaker: Oak
lines.text: The app remembers your last choice. You picked Current checkout on Anchorage, so switch back to New worktree.

lines.speaker: Oak
lines.text: When in doubt, a new worktree. It keeps main clean, and it still runs on your machine.

lines.speaker: Oak
lines.text: Done somewhere else, and your own deck stayed untouched. That's Cloud.

lines.speaker: Oak
lines.text: Fen's got crews that won't stop tangling. His boardwalk's just behind me.

lines.speaker: Oak
lines.text: Ring the gondola bell if you like, Captain. She's always running.

lines.speaker: Fen
lines.text: Oak sends the crews my way, Captain. See him first.

lines.speaker: Fen
lines.text: Ah, a captain! We used to run every crew down the Great Hall trough. Watch this.

lines.speaker: Fen
lines.text: Three tasks, one folder. Their work blurs together.

lines.speaker: Fen
lines.text: So now each crew gets its own channel. Turn the tiles, then open the gates.

lines.speaker: Fen
lines.text: The Gate Board's right here, Captain. Give every crew its own channel.

lines.speaker: Fen
lines.text: Two crews in one race! Their changes blur together, like two tasks in one folder. Give each its own channel.

lines.speaker: Fen
lines.text: That ran into the Great Hall: your main checkout. A new worktree keeps a session's changes out of main.

lines.speaker: Fen
lines.text: That water turned another crew's wheel. A session's diff should stay with that session.

lines.speaker: Fen
lines.text: It stops short. Follow it down from the gate.

lines.speaker: Fen
lines.text: One crew, one channel. Lovely! Now the other two want their water.

lines.speaker: Fen
lines.text: Three crews, three channels, one spring. That's one repository with a worktree for each session.

lines.speaker: Fen
lines.text: Och, the rain's brought a boulder down! New tiles, same rule: every crew its own channel.

lines.speaker: Fen
lines.text: Nothing mixed, round a boulder and all. Sessions can run side by side without mixing their changes.

lines.speaker: Fen
lines.text: Now Feature and Docs both want to show their work at the Lookout.

lines.speaker: Fen
lines.text: Their channels are separate. So why are they stuck?

lines.speaker: Fen
lines.text: Their channels are already apart. Worktrees separate files and branches, not ports.

lines.speaker: Fen
lines.text: That's it! Different ports for parallel previews. Docs takes Lookout 5174.

lines.speaker: Fen
lines.text: That works too: stop one server. Or start the second on 5174.

lines.speaker: Fen
lines.text: Two previews on one port collide. Try again.

lines.speaker: Fen
lines.text: Worktrees separate files and branches, not everything. Dev servers, databases and ports can still collide.

lines.speaker: Fen
lines.text: Mind, the course has you work one session at a time in this chapter.

lines.speaker: Fen
lines.text: Ines wants a word about what you pack. The Signal Deck's up the stair.

lines.speaker: Fen
lines.text: Listen to those wheels turning. Music, that is.

lines.speaker: Ines
lines.text: Fen's flumes first, Captain! He's along the boardwalk.

lines.speaker: Ines
lines.text: Context goes in the prompt box with a few special characters. Each one's a flag.

lines.speaker: Ines
lines.text: The at sign brings files or folders. The hash brings issues or pull requests, like number twelve.

lines.speaker: Ines
lines.text: A slash runs a slash command. And the ampersand points to other sessions, when the prompt box offers it.

lines.speaker: Ines
lines.text: Bring the smallest amount of useful context. Less is often more.

lines.speaker: Ines
lines.text: First order: bring the folder samples, book app web, source.

lines.speaker: Ines
lines.text: Next: bring in issue twelve.

lines.speaker: Ines
lines.text: Now: run chronicle standup.

lines.speaker: Ines
lines.text: Last one: point at another crew's session.

lines.speaker: Ines
lines.text: That's the one! Up she goes.

lines.speaker: Ines
lines.text: Got a file that isn't in the repository? Drag it from your computer onto a session or agent in the sidebar.

lines.speaker: Ines
lines.text: Not sure what commands you've got? Type a slash and read the palette. It changes with your app, plugins, skills and policy.

lines.speaker: Ines
lines.text: Today you need two: chronicle and context. Pip will show you both.

lines.speaker: Ines
lines.text: Rook's crew is across the Signal Bridge. Mind, it sways.

lines.speaker: Ines
lines.text: Smallest useful context, Captain. Less is often more.

lines.speaker: Rook
lines.text: Ines first, Captain. She's on the Signal Deck, just there.

lines.speaker: Rook
lines.text: This bough's a branch: practice empty state copy. Its empty-state message got worse on purpose.

lines.speaker: Rook
lines.text: Point to the project, select Create from, open Branches and pick our branch. New worktree, every time.

lines.speaker: Rook
lines.text: Set Mode to Plan, type hash three, pick Improve the empty state copy, and ask for a plan.

lines.speaker: Rook
lines.text: The plan opens in the Plan tab, and Review plan takes the prompt box's place.

lines.speaker: Rook
lines.text: Back in Interactive, run the Book App and open the preview. Search hobbit, then a made-up word, and note the empty state.

lines.speaker: Rook
lines.text: Then ask it to implement the plan, check the Changes tab or pill, reload, and compare.

lines.speaker: Rook
lines.text: Pip's got the day's log up in the Chronicle Loft. Up you go.

lines.speaker: Rook
lines.text: Your turn now: a light and dark theme for the Book App, in its own worktree.

lines.speaker: Rook
lines.text: Mind how you go on that bridge, Captain.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: The chronicle can wait, Captain. Rook's crew first.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Chronicle standup reports your work from the last day. It should list this session and its changes.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Slash context opens the usage popup below the prompt box. So does the AI credits icon by the microphone.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Session shows the AI credits it used. Tokens, what went to the model and back. Plan, your plan's use.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Select the Context bar for the breakdown. Check it before you pile on more files.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Select the session name at the top of the window for its branches, its Path and its Session ID.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Then ask Copilot to stop the session's development server. No pull request needed.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: The Elder's waiting at the Crown, Captain. Last flight up.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Every day goes in the ledger, Captain. Even the dull ones.

lines.speaker: Maren
lines.text: The Crown can wait, Captain. Pip's ledger first.

lines.speaker: Maren
lines.text: You've climbed above the mist, Captain. Down there, every crew works on its own bough.

lines.speaker: Maren
lines.text: Pass my Trial, and the Crown Beacon is yours to light. Nine questions.

lines.speaker: Maren
lines.text: Back for the Trial? Take your time, Captain.

lines.speaker: Maren
lines.text: The Seal of Thousand-Bough. Hold it to the Beacon, Captain.

lines.speaker: Maren
lines.text: Keelhaven's shipwrights put sessions to real work: review, debug, test and preview, then issues, pull requests and checks.

lines.speaker: Maren
lines.text: Fair winds, Captain. The Sky Basket will take you down.
